implementation: OS-backed exclusive batch lease plus durable per-call INTENT_RECORDED, DISPATCH_STARTED, and terminal reservation states
pre_dispatch_guarantees: A second batch invocation fails before preflight, client construction, or provider transport.
A stale pre-dispatch intent can be reclaimed after the OS lock is released.
A process interrupted after DISPATCH_STARTED is fail-closed as remote state unknown.
A completed call is skipped by a later invocation without a second dispatch.
